title: After Russian Diesel Deal, Trump Faces New Crisis Over Ukraine
summary_full: President Trump’s surprise decision to suspend sanctions on Russian diesel fuel stunned Ukrainian and European officials, who were meeting with U.S. envoys at an exclusive golf club near Miami.
